description: This file defines the data structures and function prototypes for managing lists of strings, including sorted and unsorted options, with capabilities like addition, deletion, sorting, splitting, filtering, and removing duplicates. It is likely used as part of a larger C project to handle collections of strings efficiently.

methods.name: string_list_init_nodup
methods.description: Initializes a string_list structure with default settings without strdup.

methods.name: string_list_init_dup
methods.description: Initializes a string_list structure with strdup enabled for added strings.

methods.name: filter_string_list
methods.description: Filters items in a string_list based on a predicate function.

methods.name: string_list_clear
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a string_list, optionally freeing util pointers.

methods.name: string_list_clear_func
methods.description: Applies a custom clear function to each util pointer in the list.

methods.name: string_list_setlen
methods.description: Sets the length of a string_list, useful for trimming without realloc.

methods.name: for_each_string_list
methods.description: Applies a function to each item in the list, aborting on nonzero return.

methods.name: string_list_remove_empty_items
methods.description: Removes empty string entries from the list.

methods.name: string_list_has_string
methods.description: Checks if a sorted string list contains a specific string.

methods.name: string_list_find_insert_index
methods.description: Finds appropriate index to insert an element to keep list sorted; indicates if the string exists.

methods.name: string_list_insert
methods.description: Inserts a string into a sorted list or returns existing if it already exists.

methods.name: string_list_remove
methods.description: Removes a string from a sorted list.

methods.name: string_list_lookup
methods.description: Looks up a string in a sorted list, returning its item if found.

methods.name: string_list_remove_duplicates
methods.description: Removes duplicate consecutive entries in a sorted list.

methods.name: string_list_append
methods.description: Appends a copy of a string to an unsorted list.

methods.name: string_list_append_nodup
methods.description: Appends a string to an unsorted list without copying, taking ownership if allocated externally.

methods.name: string_list_sort
methods.description: Sorts list entries by string value.

methods.name: unsorted_string_list_has_string
methods.description: Checks if an unsorted list contains a string.

methods.name: unsorted_string_list_lookup
methods.description: Finds a string in an unsorted list.

methods.name: unsorted_string_list_delete_item
methods.description: Deletes an item at a specific index from an unsorted list.

methods.name: string_list_split
methods.description: Splits a string by delimiters and appends substrings to the list.

methods.name: string_list_split_in_place
methods.description: Splits a string in-place, inserting substrings into the list, modifying the original string.

methods.name: string_list_split_f
methods.description: Splits string with optional trimming and empty string omission, appending to list.

methods.name: string_list_split_in_place_f
methods.description: In-place split with optional trimming and omission of empty strings.
